fusions.name: Hold Under
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A grip of water holds the target under and deals 20 damage, using up every affliction you have on it, adding their remaining damage and dealing 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Grasping Splash
fusions.desc: Throws a grasping splash of water that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 15% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cupped Palms
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Wringing Grip
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
